dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: *yawn* What time is it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: There's no like or dislike. I'm not particular with my residences.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: But it is certainly more comfortable here than at the cathedral...

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: At least no one's going to wake me up for morning prayer and prevent me from catching up on my sleep.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Haha... thanks for your concern. I just have a few things to take care of.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: I've lived this way for such a long time, it'd be strange to change.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Perhaps I'm more comfortable here than I thought I was...

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Hmm... I'm getting soft. That won't do.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: ...There's nothing to thank me for.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: ...Never mind, I know you mean well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Sure. But let me make this clear: If you're looking to confess, you should go find someone else.

choices.text: Sounds like there's a story behind that.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Ha... so, I was on duty this one time, receiving confessions from believers.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: And, it was hard enough to make sense of their jumbled confessions, but then I had to use useless words like "May the Anemo Archon bless you" to make them feel better.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Ugh. Archons have mercy on me.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: However, a lot of people believe that misfortune and suffering will never touch them because they're blessed by Barbatos.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: I mean, sure, if this way of thinking makes them happier, then they can keep believing.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Wait... Was it Bartobas? O—Or was it Barsibato? I feel like I said it wrong again.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's just Barbatos, actually...

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Yeah, let's go with that. Barbatos it is.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Um... Also, thanks.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Being able to talk to you so casually without having to worry about being nagged is quite the luxury.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Great. Then we're on the same page.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Instead of wasting your time sobbing and confessing your sins at church, you're better off repenting with concrete actions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Hmm... let's go to the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: We'll drink to our hearts' delight, and who cares if we get drunk?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: ...I've never allowed myself to get drunk.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: I used to think it was idiotic to leave yourself vulnerable in front of others.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: But my perspective on that has changed.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Huh... Maybe it's because I trust you... but that's beside the point.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Angel's Share or The Cat's Tail, which one you wanna go to?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: If it's from Dawn Winery, you can be absolutely assured of its quality.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: I'd recommend their Dandelion Wine.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: You'll throw back a couple of drinks with me, won't you?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Never mind, I'll drink for you.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Just return the favor when you're of age.

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Oh? Interested in their special cocktails, are you?

response.speaker: Rosaria
response.text: Their bartender doesn't work every day, but we can try our luck.

choices.text: I can't imagine you being drunk.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Good morning, Rosaria.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: #Oh, good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Ha, you're in good spirits. Well, if there's nothing going on, I'm off to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Rosaria.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}. Get some sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Work is probably starting for me in a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: This environment is quite relaxing.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: The sisters working at the church shouldn't be able to find this place, so I can rest without any interruptions.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Thanks for telling me about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: I didn't expect you to be into this kind of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Growing grapes — are you taking a page from Dawn Winery and making your own wine?

dialogues.speaker: Rosaria
dialogues.text: Not a bad idea. If you succeed, remember to call me over. I'd like to try some.
